scope: Local reproducible fixtures; no external simulator source was available

finite.assumptions: Finite cohort; endogenous medians, execution and settlement recomputed; fixed quantity; paired draws; unconditional profit including nonexecution; independent confirmation.
finite.interpretation: A fixed two-person cohort permits pivotal shading. Candidate changes recompute both medians, settlement and executions. This conditional-cohort counterexample is not a general Bayesian equilibrium result; bots never receive realized settlement as input.

finitePopulationAudit.assumptions: Finite cohort; endogenous medians, execution and settlement recomputed; fixed quantity; paired draws; unconditional profit including nonexecution; independent confirmation.
finitePopulationAudit.interpretation: Conditional on the observed behavioral stress cohort; this evaluates alternative orders under paired price randomness, including nonexecution, with independently confirmed uncertainty. It does not establish an ex ante Bayesian strategy or general honesty result.

heterogeneous.model: Behavioral stress fixture: period belief center uniform on [0.15,0.85); per-bot belief = 0.02+0.96*(0.35*center+0.65*independent uniform); side sampled with center probability. Research and price domains are separate.

claims: No guaranteed truthfulness, uniqueness, Sybil/coalition resistance, calibrated estimator, objective truth or production SLO.
